rule: The dominant emotion profile changes the adult archetype, silhouette, face, styling, expression, and motion—not only its palette.

sunny.face: soft lifted eyes, relaxed brows, open genuine smile
sunny.silhouette: open shoulders, welcoming hands, softly flowing plant layers
sunny.motion: warm wave, gentle nod, open-arm growth celebration

rainy.face: lowered half-lidded eyes, restrained mouth, distant gaze
rainy.silhouette: closed shoulders, long vertical layers, cool dark botanical shapes
rainy.motion: slow glance away, guarded diary hold, quiet rain-petal release

ember.face: direct sharp gaze, confident brow, controlled smirk
ember.silhouette: strong shoulder and waist line, grounded stance, restrained skin or sheer accents
ember.motion: challenge pose, protective step, forceful flame-leaf celebration

moonlit.face: watchful eyes, tense small smile or pressed lips, alert side glance
moonlit.silhouette: protective wrapping layers, asymmetric shadow shapes, guarded hands
moonlit.motion: look over shoulder, clutch diary close, protective moon-vine unfurl

sparkling.face: wide bright eyes, animated brows, delighted open mouth or wink
sparkling.silhouette: asymmetric lively stance, short bouncing layers, curious reaching hands
sparkling.motion: quick hop, excited diary reveal, spinning prism-leaf celebration

mosaic.face: calm analytical gaze with a subtle unreadable smile
mosaic.silhouette: balanced asymmetric layers, two complementary botanical motifs
mosaic.motion: measured sway, thoughtful diary comparison, balanced two-sided bloom

diary.purpose: acknowledge a newly written emotion diary

scope.juvenile_rule: Stages 1–4 remain nonsexual. Route silhouettes become readable progressively from stage 2.
scope.baby_pot_exception: Ppoto remains a nonsexual plant mascot in every route; ember means brave and sturdy, never sexy.

safety.note: Rainy and moonlit may use gothic, gloomy, or obsession-inspired fictional styling without labeling real sadness as mental illness.
